scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic: half-plane averaging gives the complex lower bound and consecutive roots of unity give sharpness. Finite numerical checks were stress tests only and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical set-sum representation only. Universal sharpness is asymptotic across hereditary families; it does not determine noncanonical embedding distortion or assert equality for every individual family.
title: Sharp complex \(\pi\)-constant for the canonical combinatorial \(C(K)\) representation
